gripeverde.field_guide.title: Survivor's Field Manual
gripeverde.field_guide.subtitle: THE REPORT CEDA TRIED TO BURY
gripeverde.field_guide.body.infection: A Ghoul's eyes shine blue. The infected are still alive, but adrenaline drives them to run faster, hit harder, and barely feel pain.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.pins: Special Ghouls can pin you down. You cannot get free alone, and the whole crew hears when someone is trapped. Stay close enough to answer.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.downed: When your hearts run out, you fall instead of dying. A teammate must hold the right mouse button beside you for five seconds without taking a hit to get you back on your feet.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.dead: If your incapacity bar empties, you die and can only watch. Your inventory stays with you, and your body remains where you fell. Only a defibrillator found in loot can bring you back.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.supplies: Supplies may run short as time passes. Search every safe room and make each shot count.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.difficulty: Easy, Normal, Advanced, and Expert are the first steps. Beyond them wait INSURGENCY I–V and INFERNUM I–V, with tougher infected, new challenges, and world events at every rise. BACKBREAKING I–X, DOOMSDAY I–X, and ARMAGEDDON I–X are still in the works.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.requirements: Seeing someone pull off a move in chat does not mean you can do it yet. Check what it asks first; your race, evolution, items, or completed missions may matter.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.regroup: Look for the white mark above your crew. It can guide you from over 3,000 blocks away, even if the land between you has not loaded.
gripeverde.field_guide.scroll_hint: Use the wheel or arrows; choose a section with 1–7.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.races: You may arrive as a Human, Shark, Cyborg, or one of more than 300 other races. Each has its own path from V1 through V4+; what you must do depends on its rarity.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rarities: From easiest to hardest to find: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Ultra Rare, Legendary, Obsainan, Mythic, Godly, Eternal, and Fabled. The same scale marks artifacts and items.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.mutation_ori: No two Ghouls change alike. Their habits, genetics, and health all seem to shape what the virus brings out.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.ceda_coverup: In 1800, CEDA called the outbreak a common flu to keep people calm. The Green Flu is a mutated, fast-acting strain of rabies mixed with influenza. It changes the living; it does not raise corpses. Ghouls are still people, changed by the virus.
gripeverde.options.sound.ui_slider.toolt: Adjust menu clicks, hovers and notifications.
gripeverde.options.sound.test_button.too: Play a short sample at the current interface volume. If it is silent, check Minecraft's master volume.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rescue_alert: That warning means one of your crew is pinned. They cannot get loose alone; find them and help them escape.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rescue_downe: At zero hearts, stay beside your teammate. Hold the right mouse button for five seconds, and do not take a hit while helping.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.rescue_dead: If your teammate's incapacity bar empties, they die and can only watch. They keep their inventory, and their body stays where they fell. Only a defibrillator found in loot can bring them back.
gripeverde.options.sound.music_slider.to: If menu music is quiet, raise Music and Master in Minecraft's Sound settings.
gripeverde.options.sound.ambience_slider: If menu ambience is quiet, raise Ambient and Master in Minecraft's Sound settings.
gripeverde.title.greeting.label: A NOTE FROM THE CHRONICLER
gripeverde.title.greeting.first: First night here? Stay close once the lamps go out.
gripeverde.title.greeting.return: Back at last? I kept the lamp burning while you were away.
gripeverde.title.greeting.remembers: I know your hand on the latch by now.
gripeverde.title.greeting.vigil: Still awake? Sit with me until the street goes quiet.
gripeverde.title.vigil.fog: Do not blink. The fog counts blinks.
